description: We are Nexora, a team of passionate STEM High School students from Egypt with strong experience in scientific research, software development, programming, and engineering. We have participated in STEM competitions and developed innovative projects, strengthening our teamwork, creativity, and problem-solving skills. Through NASA Space Apps, we aim to turn ideas into impactful solutions. We welcome motivated members skilled in AI, coding, UI/UX, data science, and space exploration.
